segments.tha-ap192:1.1: “Abhibhūtaṃ panijjhanti [abhibhūtopanijjhanti (sī.)], sabbe saṅgamma te mamaṃ [abhibhuṃ theraṃ panijjhāma, sabbe saṅgamma te mayaṃ (syā.)];
segments.tha-ap192:3.1: “Ye me baddhacarā āsuṃ, te me pupphaṃ aduṃ tadā;
segments.tha-ap192:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā tivaṇṭipupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti;
segments.tha-ap192:11.3: Isimuggo ca bodhi ca, ekacintī tikaṇṇiko;
segments.tha-ap192:11.5: Ekacārī tivaṇṭi ca, gāthā dvāsaṭṭhi kittitāti.
